entries.title: q_o congruence is exact scoped identity evidence, not an identity verdict
entries.body: QO_EQ and its finite literal-action future congruence constitute exact evidence relevant to a future-behavior identity query, but they do not by themselves establish NEI SAME.
entries.witness: Qualified NEI 0.4 treats structural correspondence as evidence unless a separate identity theorem/model family forces coidentity.

entries.title: q_r orbit equivalence is exact scoped identity evidence, not an identity verdict
entries.body: QR_EQ and its action-transported future equivalence constitute exact evidence relevant to a reflection-quotiented future-behavior identity query, but they do not by themselves establish NEI SAME.

entries.title: current future-behavior NEI query is incomplete rather than SAME/DISTINCT/UNKNOWN
entries.body: Without a represented identity-model family or exact extensional identity theorem for the future-behavior referents, the corresponding NEI query remains INCOMPLETE/UNQUALIFIED.

entries.body: No benchmark repetition, finite control count, q congruence theorem, or DP recurrence may be converted into a Bayes factor/posterior identity probability without an explicit qualified probability/likelihood/dependence model.
